title: Fix drug database list to include approved and banned drugs and verify correctness

requirements.text: Update the backend drug table source so that the drug database returns a complete, working list that includes both approved drugs and banned drugs (with correct status values) when the frontend calls `getAllDrugs`, `getApprovedDrugs`, and `getBannedDrugs`.

quotes: In drug database i need everything working correctly. please add the drugs that are approved and banned to the list, please

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getAllDrugs()` returns a non-empty list of `Drug` records.
Calling `getApprovedDrugs()` returns only drugs where `status` is `#approved` and the list is non-empty.
Calling `getBannedDrugs()` returns only drugs where `status` is `#banned` and the list is non-empty.
Each returned `Drug` has non-empty `name`, `category`, `description`, and `safetyInfo`, and has a valid `source` variant.
No traps occur for authenticated users when fetching drug lists.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend `refreshAndVerifyDrugTable` flow reliably refreshes the stored drug list used by `getAllDrugs()` and persists a `DrugVerificationResult` that the frontend can fetch via `getLastDrugVerification()`.

quotes: In drug database i need everything working correctly. please add the drugs that are approved and banned to the list, please

acceptanceCriteria: After `refreshAndVerifyDrugTable()` succeeds, subsequent calls to `getAllDrugs()` reflect the refreshed dataset.
`getLastDrugVerification()` returns the latest verification result after a refresh and returns `null` (or equivalent) before any refresh has been performed.

requirements.text: Align the Drug Database UI behavior with the backend lists so users can reliably view and filter the complete drug dataset by Approved/Banned/All without missing entries, and the Refresh & Verify button updates the table and shows the verification banner based on the latest backend result.

quotes: In drug database i need everything working correctly. please add the drugs that are approved and banned to the list, please

acceptanceCriteria: In the Drug Database module, the Approved tab shows only approved drugs from the backend and the Banned tab shows only banned drugs from the backend.
After clicking “Refresh & Verify”, the table data refreshes and the verification banner displays a clear pass/fail summary based on the refreshed data.
The counters (Total, Approved, Banned) match the current backend dataset returned by `getAllDrugs()` and update after refresh.
Search, category filtering, pagination, and CSV export operate on the filtered dataset without runtime errors when fields are missing or empty.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or the immutable hook/bootstrap files listed in `SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths`.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing real external API scraping/parsing for CDSCO/MIMS/Gazette sources (client-side simulated services may remain as-is).
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding new drug interaction features beyond ensuring the drug list itself is correct and complete.
